Super Pacs for Israel spent $16 million to defeat @RepThomasMassie. But our media will hilariously claim Israel doesn't try to control our Congress. They try to eliminate any legislator who prioritizes America over Israel. This election in Kentucky is between America and Israel.

So, @billmaher makes millions to spread toxic Israeli propaganda on @HBO and then claims to be ... the victim! If you think Israel's supporters are powerless victims in America and Palestinians are the powerful ones, you're a certifiable lunatic. He feels entitled to a genocide.

80% of Democratic voters now have a negative view of Israel. @billmaher just called all of them antisemites here. He doesn't think these voters are good-hearted people who are bothered that WE FUNDED  the slaughter of 23,000 innocent kids in Gaza. No, he thinks they only object because they have hatred in their hearts for Jewish people. That is  disgusting thing to say. 

Not only does Maher leave out the most relevant fact - that Israel did commit all of these atrocities, but he also also lies
